name: Four things we carry
text:
When we leave, we carry four things.
Fire,
water,
the seed,
and the names of the dead.
The road may take the first three from us.
It cannot take the fourth.
For the ancestors have already walked ahead.
We are only following their footprints.

inspired_by.source: Rigveda 10.14, the road of the ancestors
inspired_by.note: Original composition after Rigveda 10.14, the road of the ancestors. Not a translation, and not a quotation.
